subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw support selected-message transcript branching and multi-target composer routing as core Control UI capabilities beyond current session groups, whole-transcript forks, and split panes?
rationale: The remaining behavior requires permanent transcript-selection, state-copy, delivery, and idempotency contracts that source inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Contracts
options.body: Define additive selected-message branch/copy and explicit multi-target send semantics, with durable Project identity handled by the separate Projects tracker.

options.title: Keep Session-Level Boundary
options.body: Treat current groups, whole-transcript forks, worktree targeting, and split panes as the intended product boundary.

options.title: Consolidate Broader UX
options.body: Move the remaining message-triage details into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27526 before closing this issue as superseded.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Contracts
recommendation.body: Define additive selected-message branch/copy and explicit multi-target send semantics, with durable Project identity handled by the separate Projects tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged related implementation and have the strongest evidence of routing the surrounding product boundaries.
